ResearchProjectDef.label: hive growths
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow the first hive structures: creepers, glow pods, deep heaters, jelly farms and thornspitters, along with hive walls, hive doors, hivestone walls and insect jelly walls.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hive pods
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow specialised pods: large glow pods, firefoam pods, heat pods, staticpods and thorn pods, plus freeze pods when the black hive is present.

ResearchProjectDef.label: creep spreading
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow jellyspreaders and royal jellyspreaders that turn creep into insect jelly and royal jelly terrain, and tendril farms that seed creep with tendrilmoss.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hive walls
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build fire-resistant burrow walls and royal jelly walls, plus black jelly walls when the black hive is present.

ResearchProjectDef.label: geneline hives
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build artificial hives that spawn Kemian, Nuchadus and Xanides geneline insectoids, plus black hive insectoids when the black hive is present.

ResearchProjectDef.label: jelly morphers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow jelly morphers that refine insect jelly into royal insect jelly, plus black jelly morphers when the black hive is present.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hive defenses
ResearchProjectDef.description: Raise vilelobber mounds that spit corrosive acid, plus black defilers and bio mech disruptors when the black hive is present.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hive organs
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow hivenodes that sustain nearby insectoid structures and petroglyphers that turn rock into hivestone, plus black creepers and foam belchers when the black hive is present.

ResearchProjectDef.label: glow pod spires
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow dense glow pod formations and towering glow pod spires bright enough to grow crops.
